units.source_text: “那时我一再使用‘有人情味’这个词，K说我就是将自己的一切弱点，隐藏在了‘人情味’这个词中。

en.t: At that time I kept using the phrase “human feeling,” and K said that I was hiding all my own weaknesses inside that phrase.

units.source_text: 后来想想，K说得也有道理。

en.t: When I thought about it later, what K said did have some truth to it.

units.source_text: 但我当时使用‘有人情味’这个词，是为了让K承认他自己没有人情味，可见出发点已带有反抗性，自然不会反省自己了。

en.t: But at the time I used the phrase “human feeling” in order to make K admit that he himself lacked it; since my starting point was already defiant, naturally I did not reflect on myself.

units.source_text: 所以我仍然坚持自己的说法。

en.t: So I continued to insist on what I had said.

units.source_text: 于是K就问我，他到底哪里没有人情味。

en.t: Then K asked me exactly in what way he lacked human feeling.

units.source_text: 我告诉他：‘你是很有人情味的，或者应该说人情味太多了。

en.t: I told him, “You have plenty of human feeling; or rather, I should say you have too much of it.

units.source_text: 不过，你嘴上总是说没有人情味的话，而且还故意装出没有人情味的样子。’

en.t: But with your mouth you are always saying things without human feeling, and on top of that you deliberately act as if you had none.”

units.source_text: 我这样说的时候，他只回答自己的修养不够，所以给别人这样的印象，并没有反驳我。

en.t: When I said this, he only answered that his self-cultivation was insufficient and therefore gave others that impression; he did not argue back against me.

units.source_text: 我不但不觉得扫兴，反而可怜起他来，并立刻停止了与他的争论。

en.t: Rather than feeling disappointed, I instead began to pity him, and immediately stopped arguing with him.

units.source_text: 他的语调也渐渐低沉了下来，他神情惆怅地说道：‘倘若你知道我所知道的古人，便不会这样攻击我了。’

en.t: His tone also gradually sank, and with a melancholy expression he said, “If you knew the ancient people I know, you would not attack me like this.”

units.source_text: K所说的古人当然不是英雄，也不是伟人，而是为了灵魂虐待肉体，为了道义鞭挞身体的所谓艰苦修行的人。

en.t: The ancient people K spoke of were of course not heroes or great men, but the so-called severe ascetics who tormented the body for the sake of the soul and scourged the flesh for the sake of moral duty.

units.source_text: 他明确地告诉我，我不了解他为此痛苦到了怎样的程度，实在太遗憾了。

en.t: He told me plainly that it was truly regrettable that I did not understand how deeply he was suffering because of this.
